baseline_identity: FADA source pipeline plus Unitree G1, humanoid-gym and WBC-AGILE command-gated gait precedents recorded in the active 2026-09-07 design

primary_sources.pipeline: FADA privileged Source Oracle to Planner-IDM to target IDM LoRA
primary_sources.paper: FADA Table 5 and Appendix B source-training contract previously inspected and retained by the active design
primary_sources.implementation: ICE-Cal privileged SAC source runtime and sealed checkpoint lineage

primary_sources.pipeline: command-gated phase locomotion with contact scheduling
primary_sources.paper: Unitree G1, humanoid-gym and WBC-AGILE behavior precedents recorded in the active v024 design plan
primary_sources.implementation: src/unilab/envs/locomotion/g1 command, phase, reward and public contact-sensor owners

structure_assumptions: One canonical planar-plus-yaw command owns the exact null/non-null regime
The Actor and Critic observe command and radian gait phase
Periodic command resampling exposes stand-to-walk and walk-to-stand transitions
Public left/right net-contact sensors expose finite global-frame vertical force
The position-servo PD torque estimate uses the final target, applied gain scales and force limits
SAC, Planner-IDM tensor layout and checkpoint schema remain unchanged

mapping.pipeline_cell: source-domain objective, temporal representation and contact task constraints
mapping.adopted_mechanism: command-gated phase clock with bounded contact-schedule mismatch
mapping.essential_property: null commands produce stationary two-foot support while non-null planar or yaw commands produce a pi-separated gait clock without an exploitable near-zero regime
adaptations: Use a joint translation-and-yaw dead zone and command intensity
Use deterministic reset and command-transition phase ownership
Use public force sensing and null-only load/torque quality terms
Use periodic in-episode command resampling in the first final profile
rejected_alternatives: touchdown phase reset or learned frequency in the first profile
two separate fixed-command and transition Reward implementations

oracle.expected_property: MTC-A/B/C/D semantic fixtures pass while legacy v022/v023 characterization tests remain unchanged
oracle.failure_meaning: The implementation no longer preserves the accepted command, phase, contact, compatibility or lineage property

invalidation: The v024 Method or Training Contract changes
Command, phase, public contact sensor, torque estimate or checkpoint behavior ownership changes
The implementation introduces touchdown reset, learned frequency or a second Reward regime
